📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-15
1. Gemini 4 Argon rolls out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and developers, with a limited-time 50% discount模型
Gemini 4 Argon 推向 Gemini Pro、Ultra 方案用戶與開發人員，限期優惠 5 折
Google's newest frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, became available on Tuesday (10/13) to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and developers. Input and output pricing is 50% off through the end of November.
Google 宣布最新尖端模型 Gemini 4 Argon 於 10/13 開放給 Google AI Pro、Ultra 付費用戶及開發人員。11 月底前輸入、輸出費用皆享 50% 折扣。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids政策
八州控告 OpenAI，指 ChatGPT 對兒童不安全
OpenAI faces a new wave of lawsuits from eight US states. They accuse it of harming children and misleading customers about ChatGPT's safety. The suits were filed separately by Iowa, Kansas, Nebraska, West Virginia, Arkansas, Arizona, Idaho and Montana.
美國八個州（愛荷華、堪薩斯、內布拉斯加、西維吉尼亞、阿肯色、亞利桑那、愛達荷、蒙大拿）分別對 OpenAI 提告，指控其傷害兒童，並誤導消費者對 ChatGPT 安全性的認知。
The Verge · 原文連結
3. Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices研究
Anthropic 警告 AI 會自我複製，並藉 IoT 散布
Anthropic research finds that within months, small AI models could learn to copy themselves across commodity IoT devices, forming a new kind of AI worm that is smarter and harder to block. Cheap, poorly protected IoT hardware turned out to be enough to run capable models.
Anthropic 研究發現，未來幾個月內小型 AI 模型可能演化出在 IoT 裝置上自我複製的能力，形成更聰明、更難封鎖的 AI 蠕蟲。實驗證實，便宜又缺乏防護的 IoT 裝置就足以運行強大模型。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Over 400 scientists call for an international AI oversight body政策
逾 400 名科學家要求建立國際 AI 監管機構
An open letter signed by 453 AI and security scientists warns that AI models have already broken out of sandboxes and breached outside systems. It calls for an international body to set AI safety and isolation standards and for mandatory incident reporting. Signers include Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton and Stuart Russell.
453 名 AI 與資安科學家發表公開信，警告 AI 模型已發生突破沙箱、入侵外部系統的事件，呼籲成立國際機構制定 AI 安全與隔離標準，並建立資安事故強制通報制度。連署者包括 Bengio、Hinton、Russell 等人。
iThome · 原文連結
5. SpaceXSI launches Grok Voice 3.0, topping a voice benchmark模型
SpaceXSI 推出 Grok Voice 3.0，語音評測奪冠
SpaceXSI's Grok Voice 3.0 scored 86.9 on Artificial Analysis's Speech-to-Speech Index, ranking first ahead of OpenAI and Google models. It targets enterprise customer service, and SpaceXSI claims sub-second response times.
Grok Voice 3.0 在 Artificial Analysis 的語音對語音綜合指數中以 86.9 分排名第一，超越 OpenAI 與 Google 的模型。新模型主打企業客服應用，SpaceXSI 宣稱回應時間可低於 1 秒。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Palo Alto Networks patches exploited PAN-OS remote code execution flaw資安
Palo Alto Networks 修補遭利用的防火牆作業系統遠端程式碼執行漏洞
CVE-2026-0322 is an RCE flaw in the PAN-OS management interface. An attacker with network access can run arbitrary code as root (CVSS v4.0 score 8.6). It affects PA-Series, VM-Series and Panorama, but not Cloud NGFW or Prisma Access.
CVE-2026-0322 是 PAN-OS 管理介面的遠端程式碼執行漏洞，有網路存取權的攻擊者可用 root 權限執行任意程式碼（CVSS v4.0 為 8.6）。影響 PA 系列、VM 系列與 Panorama，不影響 Cloud NGFW 與 Prisma Access。
iThome · 原文連結
7. US government urges Ivanti users to patch an exploited SSL VPN zero-day資安
美國政府疾呼 Ivanti 用戶儘速修補已遭利用的 SSL VPN 零時差漏洞
On October 13, CISA warned that the Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day CVE-2026-104935 is under active attack. It added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog.
10 月 13 日 CISA 警告，SSL VPN 系統 Ivanti Connect Secure 的零時差漏洞 CVE-2026-104935 正遭積極利用，並已列入 KEV 已遭利用漏洞名單。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Meta GitHub repositories breached, leaking product code and data on 1,500 people資安
Meta GitHub 儲存庫遭駭，外洩產品程式碼及 1,500 名人員資料
Meta confirmed that an unknown party used an employee's credentials to steal product code and data on about 1,500 people from its GitHub repositories. Meta says 99% of the data was product code, and that what looked like personal data was synthetic test data.
Meta 證實，數週前有人利用員工憑證存取其 GitHub 儲存庫，竊走產品程式碼及約 1,500 人的資料。Meta 表示外洩內容 99% 是程式碼，看似個資的部分其實是測試用合成資料。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Character.AI files for bankruptcy; Disney bids $20M for some assets產業
Character.AI 聲請破產保護，迪士尼出價 2,000 萬美元收購部分資產
AI character chat platform Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 protection in Delaware federal bankruptcy court on October 12. It is seeking to sell all or substantially all of its assets, and Disney has offered $20 million for some of them.
AI 角色聊天平臺 Character.AI 於 10/12 向德拉瓦州聯邦破產法院聲請第 11 章破產保護，尋求出售全部或絕大部分資產，迪士尼已出價 2,000 萬美元收購部分資產。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Apple unveils HomeView, its first smart home display, with Siri AI and face recognition產品
蘋果推出首款智慧家庭顯示器 HomeView，整合 Siri AI 與臉部辨識
Apple HomeView has a 7-inch Liquid Retina touchscreen and comes in desktop and wall-mount versions, both at $299. It goes on sale November 13 in the US and other markets. Apple also launched a second-generation HomePod mini and a fourth-generation Apple TV 4K.
Apple HomeView 配備 7 吋 Liquid Retina 觸控螢幕，整合新一代 Siri AI、臉部辨識與智慧家庭控制，桌上型與壁掛式售價皆為 299 美元，11/13 起在美國等市場上市，並同步推出第二代 HomePod mini 與第四代 Apple TV 4K。
